meta.title: Navalha Barber (sample) · Classic barbershop demo
meta.description: A portfolio demo of a classic barbershop: services, barbers, monthly plans and booking. All shop details are sample content.

hero.sub: Navalha Barber is a sample classic barbershop. Browse the price list, meet the barbers and pick a monthly plan.

services.title: Pick your service
services.note: Prices and durations are sample values.

items.name: Haircut
items.desc: Scissors or clipper, finished with a neck shave.

items.name: Hair tint
items.desc: Color, tone or platinum, applied and rinsed by hand.

items.name: Beard trim
items.desc: Shaped and lined, with a hot towel.

items.name: Straight-razor shave
items.desc: Hot towel, lather and a slow razor pass.

items.name: Hair and beard
items.desc: A full cut and a beard trim in one visit.

plans.note: Sample prices. Checkout runs in test mode: no real charge.

gallery.title: The shop, in frames
gallery.note: Placeholder tiles. Real photos are added later and will be credited.

items.name: Rafael M.
items.text: Best fade I have ever had. Seen right on time, no wait, and the barber took care over every detail.

items.name: Bruno S.
items.text: The beard trim was exactly what I asked for. Clean shop, hot towel and free coffee. Already booked my next one.

items.name: Thiago L.
items.text: Booked a chair on the website in under a minute and walked in with no line. So convenient.

items.name: Diego A.
items.text: Took my son for his first haircut and he loved it. Patient and careful from start to finish.

items.name: Lucas P.
items.text: Flawless scissor cut. You can tell these guys know their craft. Recommend without hesitation.

items.name: Felipe R.
items.text: Joined the monthly plan and it is well worth it. I always leave looking sharp and the price is fair.
